subject.designNotes: Units, topic codes, titles, class periods and exam weights follow the CED. Topic skills are the CED suggested skills (Course at a Glance / unit pages). Sub-keywords, kinds, prerequisites and estLessons are original tutoring-sequence design; estLessons are scaled to roughly 60% of CED class periods per unit. Practice 3 has no MC weight (not assessed in MC).
